label.name: Star Splitter Records
label.provenance: Curatorial framework. Human creative direction and release strategy. AI may assist with public-facing communications, administration, artwork, and production workflows, but not authorship.

projects.jeff-hines: Original human compositions. Human-authored lyrics. Human arrangement and production. No AI used in the original works. Electronic production techniques used throughout. Root lineage of the Star Splitter ecosystem.
projects.star-splitter-rex: Largely faithful reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions in the Rex creative language. AI instrumentation. Instrumental.
projects.star-splitter-visions: Original Jeff Hines compositions reimagined through a distinct narrative language. Significant AI creative collaboration. AI vocals permitted.
projects.ghost-driver-unit: Highly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Collaborative human/AI lyrics. Live-band aesthetic.
projects.minor-collapse: Highly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Collaborative lyrics.
projects.night-motion-archives: Highly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Human-authored lyrics.
projects.pulse-width-codex: Highly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Lyrics primarily human with collaborative AI refinement.
projects.phase-redux: Lightly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. Instrumental.
projects.resonant-currents: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocal elements. Human-authored lyrics where applicable.
projects.ion-drive-orchestra: Largely faithful reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI orchestration and instrumentation. Instrumental.
projects.before-the-reboot: Legacy Jeff Hines compositions, primarily originating during the Cheddr era, reinterpreted through tracker-inspired production. AI-assisted instrumentation. Instrumental. Faithful to the original compositions rather than the finished productions.
projects.robots-sing-love-songs: Human-authored lyrics. AI-assisted production. Original works influenced by Jeff Hines’ compositional voice. AI vocals.
projects.supersonic-being: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Frequently collaborative human/AI lyrics.
projects.milo-bright: Highly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Includes an invented performer identity as part of the artistic language.
projects.daisy-grohs: Highly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Includes an invented performer identity as part of the artistic language.
projects.current-intents: Original Jeff Hines songwriting. Human lyrics, composition, and original production. AI used to upscale instrumentation and vocal realization while preserving the original artistic perspective.
projects.verse-assembly: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Presented with a live ensemble aesthetic.
projects.altered-velvet-band: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. Instrumental. AI instrumentation.
projects.arthur-vaughn-octet: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals.
projects.sterling-drake: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals. Includes an invented performer identity appropriate to the project.
projects.ascent-code: Lightly stylized reinterpretations of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. Instrumental.
projects.warmcircuitsrise: Highly stylized reinterpretations and remixes of Jeff Hines compositions. AI instrumentation. AI vocals.
